officialFrameMapping.how_forced_real_provisioning: Deleted data/.tongflow/plugin-venv/oneflow-api-pyscenedetect and oneflow-api-ffmpeg, then uploaded a byte-distinct copy of the example video (ffmpeg -metadata comment=<fresh-timestamp>) via the Add Video node's file input before pressing Run, guaranteeing a fresh business-input fingerprint so no node-result cache could short-circuit the run. Two earlier attempts on the unmodified example asset completed in <1s with zero milestone events -- this shared dev environment has many concurrent sibling sessions re-running the identical bundled example, which warms both the venv and the node-result cache; the fresh upload was needed to get an honest, uncached execution.
